description: Trigger evals for direction-adjust: a self-discovered mid-task course correction that deserves a D-N record and a small change of plan, as opposed to reviewer feedback, a throwaway note, a loop, a reopened locked decision, or a whole new task.

should_trigger: turns out polling won't work here, switching slice 03 to webhooks. log that so the plan matches

While building slice 02 I found the import job already dedupes by hash, so the dedupe table in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md is redundant. I want to drop that step and keep going. Write it down as a decision and fix TASK_STATE.md so the next slice starts from the new shape.

I've been on this for two hours and I now think we should paginate server-side instead of loading everything and filtering in the client. Nothing else in the plan changes. Record the change and tell me which command to run next.
Small pivot from my own testing: the settings screen should save on blur, not on a Save button. The rest of slice 04 stands. Capture it as the next D-N and update the state file.

Halfway through slice 01 I realized the cache key needs the tenant id, otherwise two orgs collide. It is a modest change to the plan, not a rewrite. Make it a numbered decision and route me back into the work.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Reviewer left 7 comments on PR #212 asking for renamed fields, an extra test, and a null check. Turn them into a backlog mapped to our slices before I touch any code.
Noticed that the retry helper logs at info level, which is probably noisy. Not doing anything about it now, just want it on record in TASK_STATE.md so I don't forget.
I keep rereading the same three files and every fix breaks something else. I can't tell if this is a bug or a planning problem. Help me get unstuck.
D-2 says we store timestamps in local time and it is marked locked. I now want to reopen it and store UTC instead, which changes what the API returns. Walk me through the options before we decide.
The team just told me the whole project is now a mobile app instead of a web dashboard, so none of the current slices apply. Start fresh on this new scope.
